summary: Petrobras files Form 6-K disclosing a judicial sale agreement for Braskem shares by Novonor/NSP Inv. to FIP (administered by Vértix Capital, advised by IG4). The deal involves common and Class A preferred shares. Terms such as price, premium, and implied value are not disclosed. Petrobras is evaluating the transaction to decide whether to exercise preemptive and tag-along rights under the Braskem shareholders agreement. FIP has submitted a binding letter to enter a new shareholders agreement with equal board and executive representation. Watch for Petrobras's final decision on preemptive rights (before the court sale closes) and the negotiation of new governance terms with FIP.
